## KEY POINT

The skinfold technique can be a practical method for assessing muscle development. However, the accuracy of results will be highly dependent on the practitioner's proficiency, and, with this in mind, findings must be interpreted skeptically. Combining skinfold measurements with circumference measurements is a viable means for tracking changes in muscle cross-sectional area, and the same caveats apply based on the skill of the practitioner.
